root: Uni-CLI 0.225.2 is the compute-contract and ref-provenance patch release: core computer-use actions now expose their arguments through describe, schema, and MCP contracts.

Compute snapshots and find results now include provider, namespace, transport, scope, TTL, stable alias, identity, bounds, and app/process provenance so agents can route refs through the owner that created them.

Compute actions now fail closed on OLo-owned, browser-owned, and unknown namespaced refs with structured foreign_ref or unresolvable_ref envelopes instead of falling through to generic compute failures.
This release also carries the post-0.225.1 MCP Origin guard, browser console evidence, JSON-RPC type-boundary cleanup, and the full verify, release-check, public-docs, and npm dry-run gates.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.225.2 是 compute contract 与 ref provenance patch release：核心 computer-use 动作现在通过 describe、schema、MCP contracts 暴露参数。
Compute snapshots 与 find 结果现在包含 provider、namespace、transport、scope、TTL、stable alias、identity、bounds、app/process provenance，agent 可以把 ref 路由回创建它的 owner。
Compute actions 现在会对 OLo-owned、browser-owned、未知 namespace ref fail closed，返回结构化 foreign_ref 或 unresolvable_ref envelope，不再落到 generic compute failure。
本次 release 也包含 0.225.1 之后的 MCP Origin guard、browser console evidence、JSON-RPC type-boundary cleanup，并通过完整 verify、release-check、public-docs、npm dry-run gates。
